Set up, with two caveats. The scheduler is not running yet because the Hermes gateway is stopped, so nothing will post until it's started. Also, the scheduler runs on real time, so the first run is Monday Oct 26 at 17:30 Chicago time, not today (Oct 14). I replied in #strategic-pod to June's message to say so.

The job is saved as 529d547bd91b. It reads #strategic-pod each weekday at 17:30 and posts a "Pod end of day" note there, or a "no new messages" line if there were none. It only posts to #strategic-pod and sends no DMs or email.
